create_pipe_transport: create a PipeTransport instance to launch and communicate with the Playwright driver subprocess via named pipes
run_transport_connect: run the Transport connect method to spawn the driver process with stdin/stdout pipes
run_transport_run_loop: run the Transport run loop to read length-prefixed JSON messages from the driver stdout
test_transport_serialize_deserialize: test the Transport serialize_message and deserialize_message methods for JSON encoding and decoding
review_transport_send: review the Transport send method for writing length-prefixed messages to the driver stdin
